controls.name: read-streams
controls.find: pub open spec fn read(window_edges: nat, cap: nat) -> Out { if window_edges <= cap { Out::Answer } else { Out::Raised } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn read(window_edges: nat, cap: nat) -> Out { Out::Answer }
controls.classification: effect: the window is read in chunks (the repair)

controls.name: as-dict-bounded
controls.find: pub open spec fn as_dict_out(total_default: nat, cap: nat) -> Out { read(total_default, cap) }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn as_dict_out(total_default: nat, cap: nat) -> Out { read(1, cap) }
controls.classification: decision: prov_as_dict reads only its edge's timestamp

controls.name: exclusive-end
controls.find: pub open spec fn in_window(ts: int, lo: int, hi: int) -> bool { lo <= ts && ts <= hi }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn in_window(ts: int, lo: int, hi: int) -> bool { lo <= ts && ts < hi }

controls.name: doc-matches-code
controls.find: pub open spec fn documented(window_edges: nat, cap: nat) -> Out { if window_edges <= cap { Out::Answer } else { Out::EmptyWithWarning } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn documented(window_edges: nat, cap: nat) -> Out { read(window_edges, cap) }
controls.classification: documentation: the guide describes the raise
